_comment: Field names and select choices of the Airtable 'Feedback' table (tblx3TH6fp4edQJDm), read from the base's metadata API. bin/test-feedback.php carries its own copy of the columns the four surveys write; this file is the whole table, so the two report-permission columns the Institutions module reads are checked against it by bin/test-fixtures.php. Several strings are load-bearing and look like typos: 'F50H- If yes or maybe: Which would interest you most? ' ends in a space, 'Mentor support - What was most helpful  and what could be improved' has two spaces before 'and', 'F1- Overall experience so far' and 'F1- How confident do you feel contributing?' have no space before the hyphen, 'F1* - ...' and 'F2* - ...' carry an asterisk, and 'Rate your mentor’s support' uses a right single quotation mark (U+2019). The two 'F3 - Report: ...' columns were created on 2026-09-02 for the Institutions module (design spec section 10) and are the last two in the base's own order. 'Course' is the column that says which program a row belongs to; the plugin fills it from the student's program. `create_records()` does not send `typecast`, so a choice spelled any other way is a 422 for the whole record. The coverage figures quote docs/specs/2026-09-02-institutions-module-design.md section 3: 834 rows, 'Institution' linked on all of them, the proud-of answer filled on 289, and the two older permission columns ('F3 - May we share a quote ...' and 'F3 - Yes, you can contact me ...') empty on every row. Refresh the field list with a metadata read when the table changes; the coverage figures need a read of the rows.
